cipher.idea: A substitution cipher based on shifting keys diagonally on a standard QWERTY keyboard. Each letter is replaced by the letter diagonally down and to the right of it. If a key is on the bottom row or has no diagonal neighbor down-right, it wraps to the top row of the next column to the right. Case is preserved, and non-alphabetic characters (digits, spaces, punctuation) remain completely unchanged.
